title: Multiplication of Gaussian phases
statement:
Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $a,b\in\mathbb R$, and let $t,x,y\in\mathbb R^n$. Define $\Phi_c(u,v)=\exp\left(i c\sum_{j=1}^n u_jv_j\right)$ for real $c$ and vectors $u,v\in\mathbb R^n$. Then
\[\Phi_a(t,x)\Phi_b(y,t)=\Phi_1(ax+by,t).\]
